value.rationale: Low-degree Walsh measurements are the canonical first interaction orders of binary-signal recovery. This finite boundary identifies the first singular third-order Fibonacci code for which linear and quadratic measurements miss every invisible character, while exactly 1296 of 8192 full Fourier modes are lost. The complete low-degree cutoff and exact natural nullity are nontrivial and reproducible, not mere recomputation of the generalized Fibonacci vertex count.
